— https://nitter.net/mattdpearce/status/1878607938547585212#m

TAX ZUCKERBERG, FUND KICK-ASS LOCAL JOURNALISTS 

mattdpearce.substack.com/p/c…
Right now, some private equity guy somewhere is like “soldiers should be allowed place Polymarket bets on in favor their own military actions to better align incentives to win battles”

Learning that “don’t gamble away national security secrets for personal gain” is apparently another issue with two sides to it.

www.foxnews.com/outkick-spor...

The AI data center / compute boom and crunch is really fucking up a lot of things: 

www.404media.co/the-ai-compu...
Old People Candy is so good. Those little strawberry candies in the cellophane wrappers printed to look like little strawberries??

One of the most indelible memories I have from college is watching the Milgram Experiment documentary and seeing the guy who stood up to the researchers and lit a cigarette while telling them he's not administering any more shocks. You gotta be that guy.
"bash them over the head with the main idea" i keep saying
“To protect and swerve”
lol @reckless.bsky.social
This is so Wes Anderson, I can almost hear the affectless Jason Schwartzmann voiceover saying "My mother used to design undercover disguises for the Stasi"
if I were The Kid I would simply outrun The Judge in a 1995 Lotus Esprit

A lot about the world is very heavy right now but if a college football podcast that got jettisoned by Vox during the pandemic for not having a marketable audience can raise this much money for refugees in Atlanta in two days then just think of all the stuff we can all do together

When I worked on legislation that would make platforms pay journalists for scraping journalism it got called a “link tax,” but when platforms make journalists pay the platform to post links it’s just good ol capitalism.
Great guest, great show
Hannah Arendt mentioned
I was telling my partner about my after-work routine and basically realized I had reinvented the experience of studying at the library

I’m reteaching myself math.
